name: Shinra
source:
Oni
Horned Demon

Weakness: Blushes easily

"You hurt? Geez...Don't worry me like that."

He may tease you mercilessly, but he'd be the first one to run to your rescue.

"I always get what I want, no matter what."

Miyabi: "What a hothead. Embarrass him and you'll see how red an oni can get."
Yukinojo: "He's very compassionate. That's probably why kids and animals like him so much."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
